svg.title: protoledger transfer matrix
svg.desc: Heatmap. Rows are source formats, columns target formats. Each cell is the percent of the source's facts preserved through source to protoledger to target to protoledger without carry. The protoledger column is the self trip, source to protoledger to source. The diagonal is the self trip.
svg.text: % of facts preserved, source → protoledger → target → protoledger (no carry)
rows: source format · columns: target format · pooled over every fixture of the source
